statement: ∀ (D d : ENNReal), 0 < D → D ≠ ⊤ → d < D + 1 → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ ENNReal.ofReal s < D ∧ d < ENNReal.ofReal (s + 1)
proof:
intro D d hDpos hDfin hlt
have hdfin : d ≠ ⊤ := (lt_of_lt_of_le hlt le_top).ne
have hD1fin : D + 1 ≠ ⊤ := by simp [hDfin]
have hDreal : 0 < D.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos hDpos.ne' hDfin
have hdreal : d.toReal < D.toReal + 1 := by
  have h := (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal hdfin hD1fin).2 hlt
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_add hDfin (by simp : (1 : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤), ENNReal.toReal_one] using h
have hmax : max 0 (d.toReal - 1) < D.toReal := max_lt hDreal (by linarith)
obtain ⟨s, hsmax, hsD⟩ := exists_between hmax
have hs : 0 < s := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hsmax
have hds : d.toReal < s + 1 := by
  have := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right 0 (d.toReal - 1)) hsmax
  linarith
refine ⟨s, hs, ?_, ?_⟩
· rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hDfin]
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hDreal).2 hsD
· rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hdfin]
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by linarith : 0 < s + 1)).2 hds
